g.text: How much RAM do you have?

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about TinyLlama for 4 GB RAM')
sendPrompt('Tell me about Mistral 7B vs Phi-3-mini quality')
sendPrompt('Tell me about Llama-3-8B performance on 12 GB RAM')

g.text: ~50% of FP16 size · balanced quality · fits most systems
Rule: model file size + 2 GB must be less than your total RAM
e.g. 8 GB system → keep model file under 6 GB
GPU backend: Intel/AMD integrated → Vulkan · NVIDIA → CUDA
CUDA adds ~2.5× speed boost over Vulkan on supported cards
